title: MotionState
description: Optional velocity/angular-velocity data. Absence or null means unavailable/not asserted, not a zero vector. velocityKmPerSec is required when a motion object is present. The payload does not identify velocity's reference frame, evaluation epoch, or whether it is co-framed/co-epoch with spatial.positionKm. No independent motion epoch or general propagation contract is provided; consumers must not treat it as request-time velocity or derive position propagation from it.

velocityKmPerSec.description: Velocity in km/s. The payload does not carry a separate epoch; its temporal association cannot be verified from this object.

angularVelocityRadPerSec.description: Optional angular velocity in radians/s; null or absence is unknown/unavailable, not zero.
